proof: W=sum local optimal values; A_i=c_i+gamma E V_i'-V_i>=0. For any lawful policy telescoping gives V_pi-W=E sum gamma^t sum_i A_i, hence G=V*-W solves residual Bellman. With finite state/action nonempty menus, zero-loss set equals greatest fixed point Z={x: exists lawful a with sum A_i=0 and P(Z|x,a)=1}. Local zero-advantage action now not sufficient. Greedy local advantage policy supplies feasible upper bound. Correlated joint transitions allowed as long as local marginal independence of other state/actions holds.
